what_to_detect: A resolution that instructs a player to suspect a permanent already suspected in the snapshot before it, and gives it no suspected designation change (no state_flag_change, no menace gained).
near_miss: A resolution that suspects a permanent that was not suspected, which gains the designation.

what_to_detect: A continuous record in which a permanent holds the suspected designation and its suspected static contributes menace to it, until it leaves the battlefield or an effect ends the designation.
near_miss: A continuous record in which a permanent whose suspected designation was ended contributes no menace from it.

what_to_detect: A continuous record in which a permanent that stayed on the battlefield is still suspected, whoever controls it.
near_miss: A continuous record of a permanent that left the battlefield and returned as a new object, which is not suspected.

what_to_detect: A continuous record in which a permanent copying a suspected permanent is not suspected: the designation is not a copiable value.
near_miss: A continuous record in which a copy is suspected because its own ability suspected it.

what_to_detect: A blockers record whose anchored attacker can be blocked only by two or more creatures (min_blockers 2 or more, as menace gives a suspected creature).
near_miss: A blockers record whose anchored attacker can be blocked by a single creature (min_blockers 1 or less).
